question: The SI unit of which fundamental physical quantity is named in honor of Charles Augustin Coulomb?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Electric charge**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Electric charge** is the fundamental physical quantity whose SI unit is named in honor of Charles Augustin Coulomb.
 
• The SI unit of electric charge is called the **Coulomb (C)**.
